g.text: DiscoveryWorld: fixed NN learning curves on existing graph features
Four predefined checkpoints; world 1 fits temperature only. Development is 2 clustered episodes in one world.
Step 0 already uses the world-0-fitted feature preprocessor. Curves do not select a replacement production model.
